description: This file defines a PHP class 'Setting' within the Opencart admin startup controller namespace. It loads configuration settings from the database, sets configuration values, and synchronizes PHP and database time zones during startup.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Controller class responsible for loading and applying system settings during startup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executed during startup to load settings from the database, set configuration values, and synchronize timezone settings.
